# Data Source Storage Nvme Namespace

Retrieves an existing single NVMe namespace.

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_nvme_namespace" "example" {
  cx_profile_name = "cluster4"
  name            = "/vol/tf_acc_volume/ns_tf_acc"
  svm_name        = "tf_acc_svm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `name` (String) Name for namespace
- `svm_name` (String) SVM name for namespace

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Namespace UUID
- `os_type` (String) OS type for namespace. Possible values: aix, linux, vmware, windows
- `space` (Attributes) (see below for nested schema)

### Nested Schema for `space`

Read-Only:

- `block_size` (Number) Block size of namespace in bytes
- `size` (Number) Size of namespace in bytes
